#####convert Seurat to Milo

```{r}
rownames(meta) <- meta$cell_id
seurat_AB04 <- AddMetaData(seurat_AB04, metadata = meta)

## keep only the conditions you care about
seurat_sub <- subset(
  seurat_AB04,
  subset = media %in% c("E8", "E6_FGF") & 
           type   %in% c("WT", "NANOG_OVER")
)

## convert to SCE and Milo
sce  <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seurat_sub)
milo <- Milo(sce)

set.seed(1)
milo <- buildGraph(milo, k = 30, d = 30)
milo <- makeNhoods(milo, prop = 0.1, k = 30, d = 30, refined = TRUE)
plotNhoodSizeHist(milo)

## count cells per sample
milo <- countCells(
  milo,
  meta.data = data.frame(colData(milo)),
  sample    = "sample_id"
)

head(nhoodCounts(milo))

#create design table
design_df <- data.frame(colData(milo))[, c("sample_id","samp","media", "type", "replicate")]
design_df <- distinct(design_df)
rownames(design_df) <- design_df$sample_id

design_df$medium <- factor(design_df$media, levels = c("E8", "E6_FGF"))
design_df$type   <- factor(design_df$type,   levels = c("WT", "NANOG_OVER"))

milo <- calcNhoodDistance(milo, d = 30)

da_med <- testNhoods(
  milo,
  design   = ~ type + media,
  design.df = design_df
)

da_med <- annotateNhoods(milo, da_med, coldata_col = "monocle_clusters")

ggplot(da_med, aes(logFC, -log10(SpatialFDR))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "DA: medium effect (E6_FGF vs E8, controlling for type)",
    x = "log2 Fold Change (E6_FGF / E8)",
    y = "-log10 SpatialFDR"
  )

## Four conditions: WT_E8, WT_E6_FGF, NANOG_OVER_E8, NANOG_OVER_E6_FGF
design_df$condition <- interaction(design_df$type, design_df$medium, sep = "_")

## make sure the control is the reference level
design_df$condition <- droplevels(design_df$condition)
design_df$condition <- relevel(design_df$condition, ref = "WT_E8")

table(design_df$condition)
# WT_E8, WT_E6_FGF, NANOG_OVER_E8, NANOG_OVER_E6_FGF

## Medium effect in WT only: WT_E6_FGF vs WT_E8
da_WT_med <- testNhoods(
  milo,
  design        = ~ 0 + condition,
  design.df     = design_df,
  model.contrasts = c("conditionWT_E6_FGF - conditionWT_E8")
)
da_WT_med <- annotateNhoods(milo, da_WT_med, coldata_col = "monocle_clusters")

## Effect of NANOG_OVER in E8: NANOG_OVER_E8 vs WT_E8
da_NO_E8 <- testNhoods(
  milo,
  design        = ~ 0 + condition,
  design.df     = design_df,
  model.contrasts = c("conditionNANOG_OVER_E8 - conditionWT_E8")
)
da_NO_E8 <- annotateNhoods(milo, da_NO_E8, coldata_col = "monocle_clusters")


## Effect of NANOG_OVER in E6_FGF: NANOG_OVER_E6_FGF vs WT_E8
da_NO_E6 <- testNhoods(
  milo,
  design        = ~ 0 + condition,
  design.df     = design_df,
  model.contrasts = c("conditionNANOG_OVER_E6_FGF - conditionWT_E8")
)
da_NO_E6 <- annotateNhoods(milo, da_NO_E6, coldata_col = "monocle_clusters")

beeswarm_WT_med <- plotDAbeeswarm(da_WT_med, group.by = "monocle_clusters", alpha = 0.1)
cluster_tab$monocle_clusters=cluster_tab$monocle_cluster
beeswarm_df_WT  <- as.data.frame(beeswarm_WT_med$data) %>%
  right_join(cluster_tab, by = "monocle_clusters")

beeswarm_NO_E8_vsWT <- plotDAbeeswarm(da_NO_E8, group.by = "monocle_clusters", alpha = 0.1)
beeswarm_NO_E8_vsWT  <- as.data.frame(beeswarm_NO_E8_vsWT$data) %>%
  right_join(cluster_tab, by = "monocle_clusters")
beeswarm_NO_E6_vsWT <- plotDAbeeswarm(da_NO_E6, group.by = "monocle_clusters", alpha = 0.1)
beeswarm_NO_E6_vsWT  <- as.data.frame(beeswarm_NO_E6_vsWT$data) %>%
  right_join(cluster_tab, by = "monocle_clusters")

stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_milo_cluster_NANOG_WT_inE8.csv")
write.csv(beeswarm_NO_E8_vsWT, stat_filename, quote = F, row.names = T, sep=",")

stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_milo_cluster_NANOG_E6_vs_WT.csv")
write.csv(beeswarm_NO_E6_vsWT, stat_filename, quote = F, row.names = T, sep=",")
```

####make summary statistics for Milo
#WT

```{r}
library(dplyr)

alpha <- 0.05
cluster_col <- "monocle_clusters"
da_results=beeswarm_df_WT
# Prep
df <- da_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_col]])) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = .data[[cluster_col]],
    is_sig  = !is.na(SpatialFDR) & SpatialFDR < alpha
  )

# Core summary
cluster_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_nhoods         = n(),
    n_sig            = sum(is_sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_sig         = ifelse(n_nhoods > 0, n_sig / n_nhoods, NA_real_),
    min_SpatialFDR   = suppressWarnings(min(SpatialFDR, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_logFC       = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_logFC     = median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_logFC_sig   = if (any(is_sig)) mean(logFC[is_sig], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    median_logFC_sig = if (any(is_sig)) median(logFC[is_sig], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    prop_pos_sig     = if (any(is_sig)) mean(logFC[is_sig] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frac_sig), desc(abs(median_logFC_sig)))

# Optional: include tested level if 'coef' exists in da_results
if ("coef" %in% names(df)) {
  coef_lookup <- df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(tested_level = dplyr::first(.data[["coef"]]), .groups = "drop")
  cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>% left_join(coef_lookup, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(
      direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(median_logFC_sig) ~ NA_character_,
        median_logFC_sig > 0 ~ paste0("enriched in ", tested_level),
        median_logFC_sig < 0 ~ paste0("depleted in ", tested_level),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
} else {
  # Fallback labels without coef
  cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
    mutate(
      direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(median_logFC_sig) ~ NA_character_,
        median_logFC_sig > 0 ~ "enriched (positive logFC)",
        median_logFC_sig < 0 ~ "depleted (negative logFC)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

# Save & view
cluster_summary_WT=cluster_summary
cluster_summary_WT=cluster_summary_WT%>%right_join(cluster_tab,by=c("cluster"="monocle_clusters"))
cluster_summary_WT$sig=ifelse(cluster_summary_WT$median_logFC_sig>0.5&cluster_summary_WT$frac_sig>0.5|cluster_summary_WT$median_logFC_sig<0.5*-1&cluster_summary_WT$frac_sig>0.4,"yes","no")

stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_milo_cluster_summary_WT.csv")
write.csv(cluster_summary_WT, stat_filename, quote = F, row.names = T, sep=",")

print(cluster_summary_WT)
message("Saved: ", normalizePath("milo_cluster_summary_WT.csv"))
```
####make summary statistics for Milo
#NANOG_WT_inE8

```{r}
library(dplyr)

alpha <- 0.05
cluster_col <- "monocle_clusters"
da_results=beeswarm_NO_E8_vsWT
# Prep
df <- da_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_col]])) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = .data[[cluster_col]],
    is_sig  = !is.na(SpatialFDR) & SpatialFDR < alpha
  )

# Core summary
cluster_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_nhoods         = n(),
    n_sig            = sum(is_sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_sig         = ifelse(n_nhoods > 0, n_sig / n_nhoods, NA_real_),
    min_SpatialFDR   = suppressWarnings(min(SpatialFDR, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_logFC       = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_logFC     = median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_logFC_sig   = if (any(is_sig)) mean(logFC[is_sig], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    median_logFC_sig = if (any(is_sig)) median(logFC[is_sig], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    prop_pos_sig     = if (any(is_sig)) mean(logFC[is_sig] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frac_sig), desc(abs(median_logFC_sig)))

# Optional: include tested level if 'coef' exists in da_results
if ("coef" %in% names(df)) {
  coef_lookup <- df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(tested_level = dplyr::first(.data[["coef"]]), .groups = "drop")
  cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>% left_join(coef_lookup, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(
      direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(median_logFC_sig) ~ NA_character_,
        median_logFC_sig > 0 ~ paste0("enriched in ", tested_level),
        median_logFC_sig < 0 ~ paste0("depleted in ", tested_level),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
} else {
  # Fallback labels without coef
  cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
    mutate(
      direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(median_logFC_sig) ~ NA_character_,
        median_logFC_sig > 0 ~ "enriched (positive logFC)",
        median_logFC_sig < 0 ~ "depleted (negative logFC)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}


# Save & view
cluster_summary_NO_E8_vsWT=cluster_summary
```

####make summary statistics for Milo
#NANOG_E6_vs_WT

```{r}
library(dplyr)

alpha <- 0.05
cluster_col <- "monocle_clusters"
da_results=beeswarm_NO_E6_vsWT
# Prep
df <- da_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_col]])) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = .data[[cluster_col]],
    is_sig  = !is.na(SpatialFDR) & SpatialFDR < alpha
  )

# Core summary
cluster_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_nhoods         = n(),
    n_sig            = sum(is_sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_sig         = ifelse(n_nhoods > 0, n_sig / n_nhoods, NA_real_),
    min_SpatialFDR   = suppressWarnings(min(SpatialFDR, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_logFC       = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_logFC     = median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_logFC_sig   = if (any(is_sig)) mean(logFC[is_sig], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    median_logFC_sig = if (any(is_sig)) median(logFC[is_sig], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    prop_pos_sig     = if (any(is_sig)) mean(logFC[is_sig] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frac_sig), desc(abs(median_logFC_sig)))

# Optional: include tested level if 'coef' exists in da_results
if ("coef" %in% names(df)) {
  coef_lookup <- df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(tested_level = dplyr::first(.data[["coef"]]), .groups = "drop")
  cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>% left_join(coef_lookup, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(
      direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(median_logFC_sig) ~ NA_character_,
        median_logFC_sig > 0 ~ paste0("enriched in ", tested_level),
        median_logFC_sig < 0 ~ paste0("depleted in ", tested_level),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
} else {
  # Fallback labels without coef
  cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
    mutate(
      direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(median_logFC_sig) ~ NA_character_,
        median_logFC_sig > 0 ~ "enriched (positive logFC)",
        median_logFC_sig < 0 ~ "depleted (negative logFC)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}


# Save & view
cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT=cluster_summary
cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT=cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT%>%right_join(cluster_tab,by=c("cluster"="monocle_clusters"))
cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT$sig=ifelse(cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT$median_logFC_sig>0.5&cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT$frac_sig>0.5|cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT$median_logFC_sig<0.5*-1&cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT$frac_sig>0.4,"yes","no")

stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_milo_cluster_summary_NANOG_E6_vs_WT.csv")
write.csv(cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT, stat_filename, quote = F, row.names = T, sep=",")

print(cluster_summary_NO_E6_vsWT)
message("Saved: ", normalizePath("milo_cluster_summary_NANOG_E6_vs_WT.csv"))
```

############################################################
## MILO: NANOG_OVER only
## Control = NANOG_OVER_E8  (your “B8”)
## Test    = NANOG_OVER_E6_FGF vs NANOG_OVER_E8
############################################################

```{r}
## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 1) Subset Seurat: NANOG_OVER only
## ---------------------------------------------------------
seurat_NO <- subset(
  seurat_AB04,
  subset = type == "NANOG_OVER" & media %in% c("E8", "E6_FGF")
)

cat("Cells kept:", ncol(seurat_NO), "\n")
print(table(seurat_NO$media))
print(table(seurat_NO$type))

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 2) Convert to Milo
## ---------------------------------------------------------
sce_NO  <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seurat_NO)
milo_NO <- Milo(sce_NO)

set.seed(1)
milo_NO <- buildGraph(milo_NO, k = 30, d = 30)
milo_NO <- makeNhoods(
  milo_NO,
  prop = 0.1,
  k = 30,
  d = 30,
  refined = TRUE
)

plotNhoodSizeHist(milo_NO)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 3) Count cells per sample
## ---------------------------------------------------------
milo_NO <- countCells(
  milo_NO,
  meta.data = data.frame(colData(milo_NO)),
  sample    = "sample_id"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 4) Design table (samples only, NANOG_OVER)
## ---------------------------------------------------------
design_NO <- data.frame(colData(milo_NO))[, 
  c("sample_id", "samp", "media", "replicate")
]
design_NO <- distinct(design_NO)
rownames(design_NO) <- design_NO$sample_id

## E8 as reference
design_NO$medium <- factor(design_NO$media, levels = c("E8", "E6_FGF"))

print(table(design_NO$medium))

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5) DA test: E6_FGF vs E8
## ---------------------------------------------------------
milo_NO <- calcNhoodDistance(milo_NO, d = 30)

da_NO_med <- testNhoods(
  milo_NO,
  design    = ~ medium,
  design.df = design_NO
)

da_NO_med <- annotateNhoods(
  milo_NO,
  da_NO_med,
  coldata_col = "monocle_clusters"
)

## Save full DA table
write.csv(
  da_NO_med,
  paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_milo_DA_NANOG_OVER_E6_FGF_vs_E8.csv"),
  quote = FALSE
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 6) Volcano plot
## ---------------------------------------------------------
p_volcano <- ggplot(da_NO_med, aes(logFC, -log10(SpatialFDR))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NANOG_OVER: E6_FGF vs E8",
    x = "log2 Fold Change (E6_FGF / E8)",
    y = "-log10 SpatialFDR"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

print(p_volcano)

ggsave(
  paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot, "_volcano_NANOG_OVER_E6_FGF_vs_E8.pdf"),
  p_volcano,
  width = 6,
  height = 4
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 7) Beeswarm + cluster colors
## ---------------------------------------------------------
beeswarm_NO <- plotDAbeeswarm(
  da_NO_med,
  group.by = "monocle_clusters",
  alpha = 0.1
)

beeswarm_NO_df <- as.data.frame(beeswarm_NO$data) %>%
  right_join(cluster_tab, by = "monocle_clusters")

write.csv(
  beeswarm_NO_df,
  paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_milo_cluster_NANOG_OVER_E6_vs_E8.csv"),
  quote = FALSE
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 8) Violin plot — logFC
## ---------------------------------------------------------

p_logFC <- ggplot(
  data=subset(beeswarm_NO_df, beeswarm_NO_df$logFC!=0),
  aes(x = factor(cluster_name_short, levels = cell_type_short_levels), logFC, fill = factor(cluster_name, levels = cell_type_levels))
) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +

  ) +

print(p_logFC)

ggsave(
```

#### make summary statistics for Milo
# NANOG_OVER_E6_vs_E8

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05
cluster_col <- "monocle_clusters"
da_results  <- beeswarm_NO_df

# -------------------------
# Prep
# -------------------------
df <- da_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_col]])) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = .data[[cluster_col]],
    is_sig  = !is.na(SpatialFDR) & SpatialFDR < alpha
  )

# -------------------------
# Core summary
# -------------------------
cluster_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_nhoods         = n(),
    n_sig            = sum(is_sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_sig         = ifelse(n_nhoods > 0, n_sig / n_nhoods, NA_real_),
    min_SpatialFDR   = suppressWarnings(min(SpatialFDR, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_logFC       = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_logFC     = median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_logFC_sig   = if (any(is_sig)) mean(logFC[is_sig], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    median_logFC_sig = if (any(is_sig)) median(logFC[is_sig], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    prop_pos_sig     = if (any(is_sig)) mean(logFC[is_sig] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(frac_sig), desc(abs(median_logFC_sig)))

# -------------------------
# Optional: direction labels
# -------------------------
if ("coef" %in% names(df)) {

  coef_lookup <- df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      tested_level = dplyr::first(.data[["coef"]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
    left_join(coef_lookup, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(
      direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(median_logFC_sig) ~ NA_character_,
        median_logFC_sig > 0 ~ paste0("enriched in ", tested_level),
        median_logFC_sig < 0 ~ paste0("depleted in ", tested_level),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

} else {

  cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
    mutate(
      direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(median_logFC_sig) ~ NA_character_,
        median_logFC_sig > 0 ~ "enriched in E6_FGF",
        median_logFC_sig < 0 ~ "enriched in E8",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

# -------------------------
# Join cluster colors + significance flag (your heuristic)
# -------------------------
cluster_summary_NO_E6_vs_E8 <- cluster_summary %>%
  right_join(cluster_tab, by = c("cluster" = "monocle_clusters"))

cluster_summary_NO_E6_vs_E8$sig <- ifelse(
  (cluster_summary_NO_E6_vs_E8$median_logFC_sig >  0.5 &
   cluster_summary_NO_E6_vs_E8$frac_sig > 0.5) |
  (cluster_summary_NO_E6_vs_E8$median_logFC_sig < -0.5 &
   cluster_summary_NO_E6_vs_E8$frac_sig > 0.4),
  "yes", "no"
)

# -------------------------
# Save & inspect
# -------------------------
stat_filename <- paste0(
  fname_prefix_stat,
  "_milo_cluster_summary_NANOG_OVER_E6_vs_E8.csv"
)

write.csv(
  cluster_summary_NO_E6_vs_E8,
  stat_filename,
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = TRUE,
  sep = ","
)

print(cluster_summary_NO_E6_vs_E8)
message("Saved: ", normalizePath(stat_filename))
```
